## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase handles an RGB optical scene in a polar stereographic CRS.

## Risk types covered

- [`crs_mishandled`](../risk/crs-mishandled.md)
- `projection_assumptions`

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `3995` |
| `expected_band_count` | `3` |
| `expected_dtype` | `uint8` |
| `expected_shape` | `[16, 16]` |
